title: Cedar Analytics: upgrade pricing for 25 seats
transcript:
Agent: Cedar support, this is Priya. How can I help?
Customer: Hi Priya, this is Owen from Cedar Analytics. We are thinking about upgrading from 10 seats to 25. I need to understand the pricing before I take it to finance.
Agent: Happy to help. Are you on the team plan or the business plan?
Customer: Team plan, billed monthly. We have 10 active seats and about four more people joining next month.
Agent: For the team plan, additional seats are $12 per seat per month. If you move to 25 seats, the monthly total would be $300. If you switch to annual billing, the effective rate is $10 per seat per month, so $250 per month billed annually.
Customer: What happens to the seats we already paid for this month?
Agent: The upgrade is prorated. You would pay the difference for the rest of the current billing cycle, and the new seat count starts immediately.
Customer: Is there a volume discount above 25?
Agent: At 50 seats the rate drops to $9 per seat per month on annual billing. We can also have sales put together a quote with a multi-year option.
Customer: That would be useful. Can someone call me tomorrow morning?
Agent: I will create a ticket for the pricing request and ask sales to call you tomorrow between 9 and 11. Can you confirm the best number?
Customer: Use the number on the account. That works.
Agent: I have created the ticket and scheduled the callback. You will get an email with the quote summary.
Customer: Thanks, Priya.
Agent: You are welcome, Owen.
